show.description: Ananya, adopted by wealthy family as their lost daughter, faces destruction when manipulative Janvi arrives claiming to be the real heir with fake DNA proof. Janvi systematically turns the family against Ananya, steals credit for her kidney donation, then frames her for attempted murder, sending Ananya to prison for three years. Upon release, Ananya rebuilds her life until the father awakens from coma, exposing Janvi as the kidnapper's revenge-seeking daughter and revealing Ananya was always the true biological child.
